summary: This directory manages the generation and export of structured data into Excel file formats. It provides the necessary interface for transforming internal application data structures, such as arrays of maps, into external spreadsheet documents.
responsibilities: Transforming application data into Excel spreadsheet format
Writing structured table data to external files
relationships: The serialization process converts internal map arrays into formatted Excel table structures.
designDecisions: Centralized export logic for spreadsheet generation
Support for array of maps as the primary input format for exports
